state.name: world_memory
state.description: Mean of the six realm meters, recomputed whenever one changes. Under 25 at the end: The Architect Rises. 65+ is needed for Remembered Whole.

state.name: echoes
state.description: Currency gained by witnessing (lore objects, Remind, Six Realms wins, Concentration pairs); spent to record, to Recall in battle, and to retell a forgotten request.

state.description: What the party has learned of who Izladar was. Nine sources (section 13); 6+ needed for Remembered Whole; 4+ before Star Chart III makes every line known.
